messages:
Anika (Partnerships): Heads up — StrataAccel EAP kickoff. NDA signed yesterday. Need to align bench plan + telemetry. Proposed phases: 1) smoke & baseline with our reference models, 2) perf + quant runs, 3) joint announcement + customer pilot. Any immediate blockers?

Josh (Eng-ML): SG. Which model families/seq lenses we prioritise? My vote: 7B instruction and 13B gen variants for perf parity checks. Need model checkpoints and their kernel specs.

Maria (PM): Timeline question — comms want a draft joint blog by May 10. Can we land perf runs by Apr 25 so marketing has time? Also we need an embargo window after final results are signed.

Kevin (Eng-Infra): Access model? Are they bringing cards to our lab or do we VPN them into a sandbox cluster? Also need to decide telemetry retention (is 30d OK) and NVMe scratch for KV cache tests.

Anika (Partnerships): They plan to bring pre-release PCIe cards to the lab next week for initial smoke. We can grant host access to their engineer Mateo. SRE jumpbox required for secure access. @LegalBot any NDA redlines to flag before we hand over hardware?

LegalBot: Reviewed NDA. Requested redlines: explicit telemetry opt-out clause, 90-day embargo on public benchmark disclosure, and SOC2 scoping language. I'll post a short summary and the addendum template to #legal by EOD.

Josh (Eng-ML): Bench harness notes — baseline script: ./run_bench.sh --model <dir> --batch 8 --seq 2048 --iters 100 --quant {none,int8}. Example run: ```bash
./bench/run.py --model llama-13b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --iters 200 --profile
``` We'll need the runtime build tagged for this run. Also request: enable --mask-pii in the harness so we don't log raw prompts.

Kevin (Eng-Infra): I'll stage a runtime image tag 'strata-eap-2026-04-01' and create an AMI for the jumpbox. Provision ETA: ~48h after approvals. I'll also provision NVMe scratch and a rotated SSH key for Mateo.

Maria (PM): Good. Marketing note: communications needs a 2-week review window for any joint announcement. Please bake that into timeline. Also need a reproducible config snapshot for the blog.

Anika (Partnerships): Proposed success metrics: throughput uplift vs baseline, p99 latency <= 1.2x baseline, cost-per-token delta <= 0.8x, plus no regression on our eval set (quality). I'll open a PR with metrics + test prompts.

Josh (Eng-ML): For evalset I'll reuse rlhf-regression set. We should also add streaming stability tests (chunking, reconnects) and a multi-tenant load sim.

Kevin (Eng-Infra): Adding multi-tenant load: sim 500 concurrent sessions, ramp 60s, sustain 10m. I'll drop loadgen config into the infra repo and share. Also adding observability dashboard placeholders (latency, cpu/gpu, nvme util, power draw).

Anika (Partnerships): Quick ops checklist before arrival: security brief, jumpbox creds, addendum signed, bench recipes, dry-run slot. Dry-run: Monday 8:30 AM.

Anika (Partnerships): @Liam (Strata) can you confirm travel and who from your side is coming?

Liam (Strata - Partner): Yes — Mateo (HW Eng) and I will arrive Mon 9am. We'll bring FW v0.9.2 and a diagnostics utility. Happy to sign telemetry addendum on arrival if needed.

LegalBot: Addendum template prepared, includes telemetry opt-out and data minimization clause. Will send offline and post summary to #legal.

Josh (Eng-ML): Note for bench recipes: include quantized int8 flows and KV cache warmup patterns. Sample flag: --kv-warmup 128 --warmup-threads 4. Also recommend running the topology scan with our fused-kernel build to check compatibility.

Kevin (Eng-Infra): Creating ephemeral credentials for Mateo now. Will rotate post-engagement and post a short runbook for access and teardown steps in #eng-infra.

Maria (PM): I'll update the project board with milestones: dry-run, bench completion, signoff, marketing review, announcement hold.

Anika (Partnerships): Final quick list of next steps: 1) Legal sends addendum (EOD), 2) Kevin stages infra (48h), 3) Josh finalises bench recipes (today), 4) Maria sets comms dates and milestone board. Dry-run Mon 8:30. Closing loop — ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
